output.summary: Reported on-time is computed against the current promised date, which dispatchers can overwrite. Revisions rose 5x after the bonus took effect. The jump came at each center when its bonus began: Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July. Operational-capacity reasons rose from 22% to 74%, revisions came later, and customer notification fell, while customer-request revisions stayed flat. This strongly suggests metric gaming, so the 98% claim is unsubstantiated. Whether true timeliness against original dates worsened, and why, is not measured yet. The campaign and a higher bonus tier are harmful. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Driver hiring is premature.
